text:
sam: ⚠️ heads-up — canary deploy at 10:45UTC bumped p99 for smallseq models (model-lite/v3q). tail jumped ~3x. Suspect new kernel_autoselect + prefetch-window change interacting with larger microbatch_max. Kicking off rollback now.

anya: :eyes: can you paste the quick flame/profile output? especially kernel selection counts and queue wait times.

sam: pasted short profile + config diff below. this is from a 10:46-10:50 canary shard.

```
# profiling summary (canary shard)
p99_latency_ms: 780 -> 2400
p95_latency_ms: 220 -> 420
avg_inflight_queue_ms: 5 -> 120
kernel_selector_hits: new_autoselect=0.64, old_static=0.36
microbatch_stats: avg=11.3 (target 8), max=16
KVCache.prefetch_hits: 0.12 -> 0.05
```

```diff
- kernel_autoselect: false
- microbatch_max: 8
- prefetch_window_ms: 5
+ kernel_autoselect: true  # heuristic change
+ microbatch_max: 16        # raised to improve throughput
+ prefetch_window_ms: 20    # more aggressive prefetch
+ kv_cache_prefetch: enabled
```

sam: observed behaviour: autoselect prefers a new fused-kernel path for short sequences, but with larger microbatches the fused path introduces serialization at kernel launch and increased GPU kernel queueing -> big tail. also prefetch and kv-cache invalidation produced extra blocking checks.

kyle: agree this smells like batch+kernel coupling. rolling back kernel_autoselect + microbatch_max to previous values should be fastest. I can run the revert.

jin: I can confirm traces show increased device-side enqueue wait. adding the smallseq-specific rule to force static kernel for seq_len<=96 would help too but that's more code. revert first.

kyle: running rollback command now:`kubectl apply -f runtime-config-rollback.yaml && deploy-bot rollback runtime v2026.11.5`

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollback initiated by kyle at 10:52UTC. target env=prod, runtime-config -> v2026.11.4 (previous).

platform-oncall: :thumbsup: monitoring metrics. watching p99 across regions.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollback completed at 10:56UTC. rollout status: success.

anya: canary metrics?

sam: p99 back to ~800ms within 90s of rollback, avg queue wait down to ~10ms. KV prefetch hit-rate recovered.

jin: nice. leaving a short hotfix ticket to revert the prefetch-window change and add an integration microbench for microbatch/autoselect combos.

kyle: created issue: https://redwood.internal/issue/RI-5563 - title: "investigate kernel_autoselect + microbatch_max tail interaction". assignees: eng-runtime.

sam: thanks all. quick postmortem scheduled 11:30UTC. we'll validate canary gating to catch this class of regression (add microbatch vs kernel matrix tests). :coffee:

platform-oncall: logging incident: INC-2026-2334, severity=sev2, brief="post-deploy tail-latency spike due to kernel selector + microbatch config"

kyle: FYI commit that caused change: 0a9f3b2 -> config tweak; rolling PR: https://git.redwood/eng/runtime/pulls/280. will add extra canary checks before re-applying.

sam: closing thread — p99 stable, metrics look good. follow-up work on the ticket.
